broadcast.setupInfo:
OBS setup instructions
1. Click the + button in the OBS Sources list.
2. Click [Browser] to add a source.
3. Copy the 'OBS Connection URL' and paste it into [URL] in the browser source properties.
4. Click OK to apply.
